root: ^"It seems like you both have very different perspectives, but there's love here, even in the tension."
^"Rocky, you're carrying pressure from your family, your community, and trying to balance that with Peggy."
^"Peggy, you're feeling neglected. Not just by Rocky's absence, but by the gap between your worlds."
^"That doesn't make your struggles less real. You've had to adjust to a world that doesn't always feel safe."
^"Yeah… where I live, I have to be careful all the time. Dodging people, watching for strays, making sure I'm not caught somewhere I can't fly out of."
^"It's exhausting. Always looking over my shoulder."
^"So when you say I was never there… you don't just mean company."
^"You wanted me there because you felt scared."
^"I didn't always feel safe. And I don't think I wanted to admit that."
^"I thought providing meant food, a place to rest. I thought that was enough."
^"I don't want you to feel like you're alone in it."
^"See what happens when you hear each other? That's the power of slowing down."
^"For now, we'll focus on three areas."
^"Imagine you go to sleep tonight and a miracle happens. Everything therapy would fix is fixed."
^"When you wake up tomorrow, what's different?"
^"She's not bracing. And I'm not proving."
